Hand colored. Relief shown pictorially and by hachures. Place names in English. Shows administrative divisions in New York and portions of New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and New England. Based on John Montresor's A map of the Province of New York, with part of Pensilvania. 1775. From Georges Louis Le Rouge's Atlas amériquain septentrional. 1778 [i.e. 1792] Includes continuations of Lake Champlain and Connecticut River. Scale ca. 1:320,000.
